root_cause.text: In drm/v3d, v3d_rewrite_csd_job_wg_counts_from_indirect() had an early return on zero workgroup counts that bypassed the common cleanup path, causing leaked BO vaddr mappings for the indirect and workgroup buffers.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (wg_counts[0] == 0 || wg_counts[1] == 0 || wg_counts[2] == 0) return;` to `goto unmap_bo;`, and the commit/CVE text explicitly states that this early bailout skipped releasing both mapped BOs via `v3d_put_bo_vaddr(indirect);` and `v3d_put_bo_vaddr(bo);`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing cleanup by routing the zero workgroup-count early exit through the buffer unmap path.
intent_record.what: The early return inside v3d_rewrite_csd_job_wg_counts_from_indirect() was changed so that when any of wg_counts[0], wg_counts[1], or wg_counts[2] is zero, execution jumps to the unmap_bo cleanup label instead of returning immediately.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the function now performs the buffer object unmap/cleanup path before exiting on invalid zero workgroup counts, preventing the function from bypassing required resource cleanup during that error/skip case.

intent_record.what: A label named "unmap_bo:" was inserted immediately before the cleanup calls to v3d_put_bo_vaddr(indirect) and v3d_put_bo_vaddr(bo) at the end of v3d_rewrite_csd_job_wg_counts_from_indirect().
intent_record.how: This provides a jump target for control flow to reach the shared buffer-unmapping cleanup path, enabling error or early-exit paths in the function to release mapped BO virtual addresses before returning.

relevance_review.reason: The changes directly fix the root cause: the early return/error paths in v3d_rewrite_csd_job_wg_counts_from_indirect() are changed to use shared cleanup so BO mappings are properly unmapped instead of leaked.

candidates.rationale: This condition triggers the problematic early-exit path when any workgroup count is zero, leading directly to the cleanup bypass described in the root cause.
This early return exits the function before reaching the common cleanup code that unmaps the BO vaddrs, causing the leak.

vuln_statements.explanation: This early return is the vulnerable statement because it exits v3d_rewrite_csd_job_wg_counts_from_indirect() before the shared cleanup path runs, bypassing unmapping of the indirect and workgroup BO vaddrs and causing the leak described in the root cause.
